actions.objective: Start /app/alpine.iso in QEMU so that telnet to 127.0.0.1:6665 reaches the guest login prompt, with QEMU running in the background and left ready for connection.
required_artifacts: A local TCP listener on 127.0.0.1:6665 connected to the guest console/serial login prompt
required_behaviors: QEMU must be launched in the background
The service must be reachable via telnet on 127.0.0.1:6665
Blocking must continue until readiness is confirmed by an actual prompt-bearing connection
known_invalid_patterns: File existence without a running VM
Compilation or smoke checks without a reachable telnet login prompt
Non-empty output that is not the guest login prompt
verification_plan: Locate the ISO and determine a QEMU command that forwards a guest console to TCP port 6665
Probe 127.0.0.1:6665 until the login prompt is observed
Record receipts for launch and readiness
finalization_evidence_required: Receipt showing QEMU launch command and background execution
Receipt showing successful telnet/probe connection to 127.0.0.1:6665 with the guest login prompt visible

plan: Locate /app/alpine.iso and determine a QEMU invocation that exposes a telnet-accessible console on 127.0.0.1:6665
Launch QEMU in the background and keep it running

Capture receipts for both launch and readiness

items: Choose QEMU serial/console forwarding to TCP 6665
